subject: Multivarate model with dataframe per formula

messages.author: 10fe9ede35190084
messages.subject: Multivarate model with dataframe per formula
parts:
Is there a way to specify a different dataframe per multivariate formula like in stan_mvmer of rstanarm? If not, perhaps there is a neat formulating trick that can achieve the same result?

My data set consists of experiments done on guinea pig tissue, and I'll simplify the data to the crux of the issue. Two electrodes measuring neural firing, per tissue, with a predictor of distance ("dist") of each electrode to a marker on the tissue. Each electrode has an outcome of firing rate (let's label it "hz") and there is also an outcome of cross-correlation between the two electrodes ("xc"). So essentially the "hz" outcome data has twice the number of rows as the "xc" outcome. Electrode 1 of a guinea pig should not be considered the same as electrode 1 of any other guinea pig, that is, whether the electrode is 1 or 2 does not have an effect, only the distance "d" will have an effect. "xc" is dependent on the separation between the electrodes "sep".

hz ~ dist + (1 | tissue)
xc ~ sep + (1 | tissue)

I would like to supply the full dataframe to the first formula, and the reduced dataframe for the second. I can supply one dataframe, but each "xc" outcome is duplicated artificially doubling the amount of data for it.

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Multivarate model with dataframe per formula
parts:
I am not sure, but I currently see no way of reasonably expressing this in terms of one data.frame.

So basically, we need brms to support multiple data.frames. If you like, please open an issue on github so that I don't forget about it.
